description: We are students from Instituto Cervino.
summary:
In this activity we are going to talk about our challenge Space Game which we are going to show all the process of how we did the game. 
Our first ideas were to make a physical game, like a lottery or a board game, but we figured out that it would be more fun to create an online game. At first, we researched information about NASA to decide which questions to include in our game. Once we had enough information about NASA, we started creating our NASA space game.
details: Our project is a multiple-choice question and answer game. We used Genially to develop it. The benefits of the game are that those who play it will have more knowledge about that topic. Our project is very creative because we developed the idea of making a fun and easy to understand game, we chose the design, the questions, etc.
